label: ZFTA::RELA

sections.text: ZFTA encodes a zinc-finger protein with chromatin-binding activity.
RELA encodes p65, a transcriptional subunit of the NF-kappaB complex.

The fusion combines ZFTA chromatin targeting with RELA transcriptional activation, recruiting chromatin regulators and activating oncogenic transcription, including NF-kappaB-associated programs. It is the predominant fusion in ZFTA-fusion-positive supratentorial ependymoma.
